criteria.requirement: Repair both comma_first and compact CLI options as one boolean parsing family. Preserve explicit True/False compatibility with case-insensitive true/false/1/0 only, support bare option as true and --no-comma-first/--no-compact as false, define repeated options as last-wins and reject empty/unknown literals with argparse usage error. Defaults remain false and Python formatter API semantics unchanged. Verify actual formatted output, not only argparse fields, and document that a filename should precede an optional-value boolean or follow -- to avoid optional argument ambiguity.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
